narr: A derecho moved across northern Illinois during the evening of July 15th producing widespread wind damage and 30 tornadoes in northeast Illinois. One of these tornadoes crossed into northwest Indiana. At the height of the storms, 430,000 customers lost power with some power not restored for four days, on July 19th.
ev: Flash flooding occurred across portions of northeast Lake County with several roads flooded and closed. Near Gurnee, Grand Avenue just east of O'Plaine Road was flooded and impassable at the railroad underpass; Old Grand Avenue at Depot Road was flooded near the railroad tracks and Route 41 was closed just west of Delany Road. In Waukegan, Sunset Road was closed due to flooding between Northwestern Avenue and Delany Road. In Park City, several inches of water covered Washington Street near Teske Boulevard. Street flooding was reported in Beach Park. Storm total rainfall amounts included 2.40 inches at the Waukegan Airport, 2.35 inches near Winthrop Harbor and 2.20 inches near Zion.
